framings.label: Accountability and legal limits
framings.description: Frames ICE as having expanded beyond its legal authorities and oversight, focusing on remedies, prosecution of agents, masked or unidentified officers, and court rulings.

framings.label: Waste and harm critique
framings.description: Presents ICE practices as problematic, wasteful or harmful, citing reports, polls showing public disapproval, and individual cases such as detained children, courthouse re-arrests and hospital presence.

framings.label: Local-federal cooperation disputes
framings.description: Treats ICE as a matter of state and local policy choices, covering 287(g) agreements, task forces, police alerts, sheriff and governor stances, and legislation.

framings.label: Trump policy and personnel
framings.description: Explains ICE enforcement through the Trump administration's agenda, key figures such as Stephen Miller and new ICE leadership, and the political direction of deportation policy.

framings.label: Explainer and insider perspective
framings.description: Offers informational or expert-led background on what ICE is, what powers agents have and why enforcement has become aggressive, often through former officials or legal analysts.
